picked.picture: grumpy looking cat with frowning face in front of a house burning in flames and black smoke

picked.name: At Least You Tried
picked.core: Condescending consolation to someone who failed but made an effort.
slots: 'at least' or the setup of effort
picked.picture: white wolf pup patting another wolf pup on the head consolingly, lying in the snow

picked.name: Expectation vs. Reality
picked.core: Hopeful expectation versus disappointing reality, shown by a disappointed man looking away.
slots: the hopeful expectation or normal action
picked.picture: black man smiling happily then disappointed, two panels top and bottom, blank space on left

picked.name: SpongeBob Happy And Sad
picked.core: SpongeBob grinning with excitement then bawling, used for expectations versus the crushing reality.
picked.picture: cartoon yellow sponge grinning excitedly with fists, then sitting crying fountains of tears, two panels top and bottom

picked.name: This is Fine
picked.core: Calmly insisting everything is fine while surrounded by disaster.
slots: the escalating disaster or stressful situation (often blank)
calm denial line, e.g. 'this is fine'
picked.picture: cartoon dog in hat sitting at table in burning room, calm smile, coffee mug, flames everywhere

picked.name: Handsome Squidward
picked.core: Handsome Squidward versus his normal ugly face, contrasting an idealised version with the grim reality.
picked.picture: handsome chiseled cartoon squid man glowing, then ugly squid staring in horror at it, two panels top and bottom
